source.text: בְּיָמָ֣יו עָלָ֔ה נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַיְהִי־ל֨וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים עֶ֨בֶד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וַיָּ֖שָׁב וַיִּמְרָד־בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: In his days came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and became to him Jehoiakim [a] servant three years; and he turned and rebelled against him.

en.L: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant [for] three years; then he turned and rebelled against him.
en.B: In Jehoiakim's days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.
en.R: While Jehoiakim was king, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded the land. For three years Jehoiakim had to serve him. Then Jehoiakim turned against him and rebelled.

es.L: En sus días subió Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, y Joacim fue su siervo [por] tres años; luego se volvió y se rebeló contra él.
es.B: En los días de Joacim subió Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, y Joacim fue su vasallo durante tres años. Luego cambió de rumbo y se rebeló contra él.
es.R: Mientras Joacim era rey, Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, invadió el país. Durante tres años Joacim tuvo que someterse a él. Después Joacim se volvió contra él y se rebeló.

fr.L: En ses jours, Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, monta, et Joïaqim fut son serviteur [pendant] trois ans ; puis il se détourna et se révolta contre lui.
fr.B: Du temps de Joïaqim, Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, monta contre le pays, et Joïaqim fut son vassal pendant trois ans. Puis il changea d’attitude et se révolta contre lui.
fr.R: Pendant que Joïaqim était roi, Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, a envahi le pays. Pendant trois ans, Joïaqim a dû le servir. Ensuite Joïaqim s’est retourné contre lui et s’est révolté.

sw.L: Katika siku zake Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli alipanda, naye Yehoyakimu akawa mtumwa wake [kwa] miaka mitatu; kisha akageuka, akamwasi.
sw.B: Katika siku za Yehoyakimu, Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli alipanda, naye Yehoyakimu akawa mfalme mtumishi wake kwa miaka mitatu. Kisha akageuka, akamwasi.
sw.R: Yehoyakimu alipokuwa mfalme, Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli aliivamia nchi. Kwa miaka mitatu Yehoyakimu alilazimika kumtumikia. Kisha Yehoyakimu akamgeuka, akamwasi.

vi.L: Trong đời ông, Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn đi lên, và Giê-hô-gia-kim trở thành đầy tớ của vua ấy ba năm; rồi ông quay lại nổi loạn chống vua ấy.
vi.B: Trong đời Giê-hô-gia-kim, Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn kéo lên, và Giê-hô-gia-kim làm chư hầu cho vua ấy ba năm. Rồi ông quay ra nổi loạn chống lại vua ấy.
vi.R: Khi Giê-hô-gia-kim đang làm vua, Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn kéo quân vào xứ. Trong ba năm, Giê-hô-gia-kim phải thần phục vua ấy. Rồi Giê-hô-gia-kim quay ra chống lại và nổi loạn.

ko.L: 그의 날들에 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 올라왔고, 여호야김이 삼 년 동안 그의 종이 되었다. 그러다가 그가 돌아서서 그에게 반역했다.
ko.B: 여호야김이 다스리던 때에 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 쳐들어왔다. 여호야김은 삼 년 동안 그의 신하 노릇을 했으나, 그 뒤에 돌아서서 그에게 반역했다.
ko.R: 여호야김이 왕으로 있을 때 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 그 땅에 쳐들어왔다. 여호야김은 삼 년 동안 그를 섬겨야 했다. 그러다가 여호야김은 마음을 바꾸어 그에게 반역했다.

decisions.choice: in his days: during the reign of Jehoiakim, when Babylon took over from Egypt
decisions.reason: "His" is Jehoiakim, whose reign began in 23:36. Pharaoh Neco had put him on the throne and made him pay tribute (23:34-35). Babylon then defeated Egypt at Carchemish on the Euphrates in the fourth year of Jehoiakim (Jeremiah 46:2), about 605 BC, and Nebuchadnezzar came west to claim the lands Egypt had held (verse 7). This is the first time Kings names him.

decisions.choice: servant: a vassal king, ruling under Babylon and paying it tribute
decisions.reason: The word for a slave or servant is used of a whole king or people that is subject to a stronger king (17:3; 18:7). Jehoiakim kept his throne but owed Nebuchadnezzar loyalty and yearly payments.

decisions.choice: he turned and rebelled: he changed course and threw off Babylon's rule
decisions.reason: The verb "turned" before another verb marks a change of direction: after three years of submission Jehoiakim reversed his policy. To rebel against a king is to refuse him the tribute and loyalty owed (18:7).

decisions.choice: vassal (Balanced); had to serve him (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "servant". Here the word names a subject king, not a household servant or a court official, so Balanced says "vassal" and Readable says what that meant for Jehoiakim. Balanced names Jehoiakim for "his days" so the reader knows whose reign is meant.

decisions.choice: "Nabucodonosor"; "siervo" (L); "vasallo" (B); "tuvo que someterse a él" (R)
decisions.reason: "Nabucodonosor" as the terms note's table gives it; the word names a subject king (m2), worded at each level as at 17:3.

decisions.choice: Nabuchodonosor
decisions.reason: The usual French form, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: mtumwa (Literal); mfalme mtumishi (Balanced); alilazimika kumtumikia (Readable)
decisions.reason: A vassal king, in the wording used for Hoshea at 17:3.

decisions.choice: "종" (L); "신하 노릇을 하다" (B); "섬겨야 했다" (R)
decisions.reason: As 17:3, the vassal relation: Balanced uses "신하", Readable says what it meant.

source.text: וַיְשַׁלַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה׀בּ֡וֹ אֶת־גְּדוּדֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּים֩ וְאֶת־גְּדוּדֵ֨י אֲרָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת׀גְּדוּדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֗ב וְאֵת֙ גְּדוּדֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־עַמּ֔וֹן וַיְשַׁלְּחֵ֥ם בִּֽיהוּדָ֖ה לְהַֽאֲבִיד֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Yahweh against him bands of Chaldeans and bands of Aram and bands of Moab and bands of [the] sons of Ammon, and he sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to [the] word of Yahweh which he spoke by [the] hand of his servants the prophets.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent against him raiding bands of [the] Chaldeans and raiding bands of Aram and raiding bands of Moab and raiding bands of the sons of Ammon; and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke by the hand of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} slaves the prophets.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sent raiding bands of Chaldeans, Arameans, Moabites and Ammonites against him. He sent them against Judah to destroy it, in keeping with the word {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sent bands of raiders against Jehoiakim: Chaldeans, Arameans, Moabites and Ammonites. He sent them to attack Judah and destroy it. This was what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said would happen when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió contra él bandas de caldeos, y bandas de Aram, y bandas de Moab y bandas de los hijos de Amón; y los envió contra Judá para destruirla, conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que había hablado por mano de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió contra él bandas de saqueadores caldeos, arameos, moabitas y amonitas. Los envió contra Judá para destruirla, conforme a la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho por medio de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió bandas de saqueadores contra Joacim: caldeos, arameos, moabitas y amonitas. Los envió para atacar a Judá y destruirla. Esto era lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho que pasaría cuando habló por medio de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} envoya contre lui des bandes de Chaldéens, des bandes d’Aram, des bandes de Moab et des bandes des fils d’Ammon ; et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les envoya contre Juda pour le faire périr, selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dite par la main de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} esclaves les prophètes.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} envoya contre lui des bandes de pillards chaldéens, araméens, moabites et ammonites. Il les envoya contre Juda pour le détruire, conformément à la parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait prononcée par {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs les prophètes.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a envoyé contre Joïaqim des bandes de pillards : des Chaldéens, des Araméens, des Moabites et des Ammonites. Il les a envoyés attaquer Juda pour le détruire. C’était ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait annoncé quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait parlé par {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs les prophètes.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akatuma juu yake vikosi vya Wakaldayo na vikosi vya Aramu na vikosi vya Moabu na vikosi vya wana wa Amoni; akavituma juu ya Yuda ili kuiangamiza, sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilolinena kwa mkono wa watumwa {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} manabii.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alituma juu yake vikosi vya wavamizi vya Wakaldayo, Waaramu, Wamoabu na Waamoni. Akavituma juu ya Yuda ili kuiangamiza, sawasawa na neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amelinena kupitia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} manabii.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alituma makundi ya wavamizi kumshambulia Yehoyakimu: Wakaldayo, Waaramu, Wamoabu na Waamoni. Aliyatuma kuishambulia Yuda na kuiangamiza. Hivyo ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amesema itakavyotokea alipozungumza kupitia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} manabii.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai đến đánh ông các toán quân cướp Canh-đê, các toán quân cướp A-ram, các toán quân cướp Mô-áp và các toán quân cướp của con cháu Am-môn; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai chúng đến đánh Giu-đa để hủy diệt nó, theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán bởi tay các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai các toán quân cướp người Canh-đê, người A-ram, người Mô-áp và người Am-môn đến đánh ông. Ngài sai chúng đến đánh Giu-đa để hủy diệt xứ ấy, đúng như lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai các toán quân cướp đến đánh Giê-hô-gia-kim: người Canh-đê, người A-ram, người Mô-áp và người Am-môn. Ngài sai chúng đến tấn công Giu-đa và hủy diệt xứ ấy. Đây là điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã báo trước khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán qua các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 갈대아 사람들의 약탈대와 아람의 약탈대와 모압의 약탈대와 암몬 자손의 약탈대를 그에게 보내셨다. 그분께서 그들을 유다로 보내어 그것을 멸하게 하셨다. 이는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 종 예언자들의 손으로 하신 말씀대로였다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 갈대아 사람들과 아람 사람들과 모압 사람들과 암몬 사람들의 약탈대를 그에게 보내셨다. 그분께서는 그들을 유다로 보내어 유다를 멸망시키게 하셨다. 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 종 예언자들을 통하여 하신 말씀대로였다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호야김을 치려고 약탈자 무리들을 보내셨다. 그들은 갈대아 사람들과 아람 사람들과 모압 사람들과 암몬 사람들이었다. 그분께서는 그들을 보내어 유다를 공격하고 멸망시키게 하셨다. 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 종 예언자들을 통하여 일어날 것이라고 말씀하신 그대로였다.

decisions.choice: Yahweh sent them: the raids were Yahweh's doing
decisions.reason: The verse says twice that Yahweh sent the raiders. The attacks of the neighboring peoples are told as his judgment on Judah, not only as border warfare after Jehoiakim's rebellion.

decisions.choice: Chaldeans, Aram, Moab, the sons of Ammon: Babylon's forces and Judah's neighbors
decisions.reason: The Chaldeans were the people of southern Mesopotamia whose kings, Nebuchadnezzar among them, now ruled Babylon. Aram lay to the north-east of Israel, and Moab and Ammon east of the Jordan; all three were under Babylon's control and joined in harassing Judah. A raiding band is a troop that strikes and plunders, not a full army.

decisions.choice: to destroy it: Judah
decisions.reason: The pronoun is singular and points back to Judah. The raids were meant to bring Judah to ruin, not only to punish its king.

decisions.choice: the word of Yahweh spoken through his servants the prophets
decisions.reason: Under Manasseh, Yahweh had said through his servants the prophets that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and Judah and hand them over to their enemies (21:10-15). Huldah repeated it to Josiah (22:16-17).

decisions.choice: slaves (Literal); servants (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 17:13: "slave" at Literal and "servant" at Balanced and Readable for those who belong to Yahweh and speak for him.

decisions.choice: Arameans, Moabites and Ammonites
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the peoples rather than their lands ("bands of Aram", "of Moab", "of the sons of Ammon"), and say "raiding bands" once for all four. Readable names Jehoiakim for "him".

decisions.choice: "siervos"
decisions.reason: As the Psalms terms note sets for Spanish, God's servants the prophets are "siervos" at every level.

source.text: אַ֣ךְ׀עַל־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה לְהָסִ֖יר מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑יו בְּחַטֹּ֣את מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely at [the] mouth of Yahweh it came against Judah, to remove [them] from before his face, because of [the] sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,

en.L: Surely at the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} this came upon Judah, to remove [them] from before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face, because of the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he had done,
en.B: Surely it was at the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that this came upon Judah, to put them away from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence because of Manasseh's sins, all that he had done,
en.R: This happened to Judah because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded it. He was going to send the people away from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence because of the sins of Manasseh and all the evil he had done.

es.L: Ciertamente por mandato {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino esto sobre Judá, para quitar[los] de delante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro, por los pecados de Manasés, conforme a todo lo que hizo,
es.B: Ciertamente fue por mandato {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que esto le sucedió a Judá, para apartarlos de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia por los pecados de Manasés, por todo lo que había hecho,
es.R: Esto le sucedió a Judá porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ordenó. Iba a echar al pueblo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia por los pecados de Manasés y por todo el mal que había hecho.

fr.L: Certes, c’est sur l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que cela arriva contre Juda, pour l’ôter de devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face, à cause des péchés de Manassé, selon tout ce qu’il avait fait,
fr.B: Oui, c’est sur l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que cela arriva à Juda, pour le rejeter loin de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence à cause des péchés de Manassé, de tout ce qu’il avait fait,
fr.R: Cela est arrivé à Juda parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné. Il allait renvoyer le peuple loin de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} à cause des péchés de Manassé et de tout le mal qu’il avait fait.

sw.L: Hakika kwa kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} jambo hili liliijia Yuda, ili [kuwaondoa] mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kwa sababu ya dhambi za Manase, sawasawa na yote aliyoyafanya,
sw.B: Hakika ilikuwa kwa amri ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwamba jambo hili liliijia Yuda, ili kuwaondoa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa sababu ya dhambi za Manase, yote aliyoyafanya,
sw.R: Jambo hili liliipata Yuda kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliamuru. Alikuwa amekusudia kuwaondoa watu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa sababu ya dhambi za Manase na maovu yote aliyoyafanya.

vi.L: Thật vậy, theo lệnh miệng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà điều này đến trên Giu-đa, để dời [họ] khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì các tội của Ma-na-se, theo mọi điều ông đã làm,
vi.B: Thật vậy, chính theo lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà điều này xảy đến cho Giu-đa, để dời họ khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì các tội của Ma-na-se, mọi điều ông đã làm,
vi.R: Việc này xảy đến cho Giu-đa vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền như vậy. Ngài sắp đuổi dân chúng đi khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vì các tội của Ma-na-se và mọi điều ác ông đã làm.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 입의 [명령으로] 이 일이 유다에 닥쳤다. 그들을 그분의 얼굴 앞에서 없애시려는 것이었다. 므낫세의 죄들, 곧 그가 행한 모든 일 때문이었다.
ko.B: 참으로 이 일이 유다에 닥친 것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령 때문이었다. 므낫세의 죄, 곧 그가 저지른 모든 일 때문에 그들을 그분 앞에서 없애 버리시려는 것이었다.
ko.R: 이런 일이 유다에 일어난 것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그렇게 명령하셨기 때문이다. 그분께서는 므낫세의 죄와 그가 저지른 모든 악한 일 때문에 백성을 그분 앞에서 쫓아내려 하셨다.

decisions.choice: surely: this happened in fact, and for this reason
decisions.reason: The opening word stresses what follows. It can also mean "only", which would give "only at Yahweh's command"; either way the point is that the disaster did not come by chance but at Yahweh's word.

decisions.choice: at the mouth of Yahweh: at Yahweh's command
decisions.reason: What comes from someone's mouth is their order. Yahweh had spoken, and what he said now came about (verse 2).

decisions.choice: to remove from before his face: to drive Judah out of the land where Yahweh is present
decisions.reason: To remove from Yahweh's face is to send away from his presence, from the land and the temple where he had put his name. The same words were used of the northern kingdom's exile (17:18, 23) and of Yahweh's decision about Judah (23:27). "Them" is supplied: the people of Judah.

decisions.choice: because of the sins of Manasseh
decisions.reason: Manasseh rebuilt the high places, set up altars to the host of heaven in the temple courts and made his son pass through the fire (21:2-9). Even Josiah's reform did not turn back Yahweh's anger over what Manasseh had done (23:26). The sentence continues in verse 4.

decisions.choice: Surely it was at the command of ... that; because ... commanded it
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the stress where the Hebrew does, on Yahweh's command, with an English "it was ... that". Readable makes the command the reason and ends the sentence early, naming "the people" as those sent away.

decisions.choice: "por mandato del SEÑOR"
decisions.reason: Every level gives the sense of "at the mouth of the LORD", his command (m2); "por boca de" would read as speech only.

decisions.choice: Verse 3 closes its sentence; verse 4 begins "또" with the second cause
decisions.reason: Korean needs the verb at the end; each verse keeps its own reason after its marker.

source.text: וְגַ֤ם דַּֽם־הַנָּקִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁפָ֔ךְ וַיְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑י וְלֹֽא־אָבָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לִסְלֹֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: and also [the] blood of the innocent which he shed, and he filled Jerusalem [with] innocent blood, and not was willing Yahweh to forgive.

en.L: and also the innocent blood that he had shed; for he filled Jerusalem [with] innocent blood, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was not willing to forgive.

en.R: Manasseh had also killed many innocent people. He filled Jerusalem with their blood, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} would not forgive that.

ko.L: 또 그가 흘린 무죄한 피 때문이었다. 그가 예루살렘을 무죄한 피로 채웠으므로, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 용서하기를 원하지 않으셨다.
ko.B: 또 그가 흘린 무죄한 사람들의 피 때문이기도 했다. 그는 예루살렘을 무죄한 사람들의 피로 가득 채웠고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그것을 용서하려 하지 않으셨다.
ko.R: 므낫세는 또 죄 없는 사람들을 많이 죽였다. 그는 예루살렘을 그들의 피로 가득 채웠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그 죄를 용서하지 않으셨다.

decisions.choice: shed innocent blood: put to death people who had done nothing to deserve it
decisions.reason: Blood stands for a life taken by violence. Innocent blood is the blood of people killed unjustly, which the law said defiles the land and cries out for justice (Deuteronomy 19:10; 21:8-9).

decisions.choice: he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood
decisions.reason: These are almost the words of 21:16, which says Manasseh shed so much innocent blood that he filled Jerusalem from one end to the other.

decisions.choice: Yahweh was not willing to forgive
decisions.reason: The verb is used of Yahweh's pardon. Here Yahweh refuses it: the guilt of Manasseh's reign remained on Jerusalem and was not taken away, even by Josiah's reform (23:26). The verb means unwilling, not unable.

decisions.choice: had also killed many innocent people
decisions.reason: Readable says what shedding innocent blood means and names Manasseh, since Readable ended the sentence at verse 3. "Many" stands for filling the city with blood.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah: a royal record the writer could consult
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in Kings (12:20; 1 Kings 15:7), the writer sends the reader to a fuller written record of Judah's kings, now lost. The question "are they not written ...?" means "they are written".

decisions.choice: a statement in place of the question
decisions.reason: As in the sources formula throughout these books, Balanced and Readable state as a fact what the Hebrew asks as a question; Literal keeps the question.

decisions.choice: "el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Judá" (L); "el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Judá" (B); "la historia de los reyes de Judá" (R)
alternatives: el libro de las Crónicas de los reyes de Judá
decisions.reason: The source formula keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets it, and avoids "Crónicas", the Spanish title of the book of Chronicles.

ko.B: 여호야김은 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 그의 아들 여호야긴이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: he died; no burial is mentioned
decisions.reason: The usual formula for a king's death is followed here without the usual note of his burial. Jeremiah had said Jehoiakim would not be mourned and would have "the burial of a donkey", dragged out beyond the gates (Jeremiah 22:18-19; 36:30). 2 Chronicles 36:6 says Nebuchadnezzar bound him in bronze chains to take him to Babylon. The text does not say how these accounts fit together.

decisions.choice: Jehoiachin: also called Jeconiah and Coniah
decisions.reason: The name means "Yahweh will establish". Other books call the same king Jeconiah (1 Chronicles 3:16; Jeremiah 24:1) and Coniah (Jeremiah 22:24), shorter or reordered forms of the same name. Every level keeps the form this verse uses.

decisions.choice: rested with his ancestors (Balanced); died (Readable)
decisions.reason: The death formula as in the rest of Kings. Readable says only "died" because the verse names no burial.

decisions.choice: "durmió con sus padres" (L); "descansó con sus antepasados" (B); "murió" (R); "Joaquín"
decisions.reason: The death and successor formulas keep the terms note's wording; "Joaquín" as its table gives Jehoiachin, kept apart from "Joacim" (Jehoiakim), and "Jeconías" where a verse uses that name.

decisions.choice: Joïakin
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for Jehoiachin, kept apart from Joïaqim (Jehoiakim) by its ending; Jeconiah is "Jéchonias" where the Hebrew uses that name.

en.L: And the king of Egypt did not again come out from his land, for the king of Babylon had taken, from the Wadi of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that had belonged to the king of Egypt.
en.B: The king of Egypt did not again march out from his own land, for the king of Babylon had taken everything that had belonged to the king of Egypt, from the Wadi of Egypt to the Euphrates River.
en.R: The king of Egypt never again led his army out of his own country. The king of Babylon had taken over all the land the king of Egypt had ruled, from the Wadi of Egypt in the south to the Euphrates River in the north.

es.L: Y el rey de Egipto no volvió a salir de su tierra, porque el rey de Babilonia había tomado, desde el torrente de Egipto hasta el río Éufrates, todo lo que había sido del rey de Egipto.
es.B: El rey de Egipto no volvió a salir de su propia tierra, porque el rey de Babilonia se había apoderado de todo lo que había pertenecido al rey de Egipto, desde el torrente de Egipto hasta el río Éufrates.
es.R: El rey de Egipto nunca más salió de su país con su ejército. El rey de Babilonia se había apoderado de toda la tierra que el rey de Egipto había gobernado, desde el torrente de Egipto en el sur hasta el río Éufrates en el norte.

fr.B: Le roi d’Égypte ne sortit plus de son pays, car le roi de Babylone avait pris tout ce qui appartenait au roi d’Égypte, depuis le torrent d’Égypte jusqu’à l’Euphrate.
fr.R: Le roi d’Égypte n’est plus jamais sorti de son pays avec son armée. Le roi de Babylone avait pris tout le territoire que le roi d’Égypte gouvernait, depuis le torrent d’Égypte au sud jusqu’à l’Euphrate au nord.

sw.B: Mfalme wa Misri hakutoka tena katika nchi yake mwenyewe kwenda vitani, kwa sababu mfalme wa Babeli alikuwa ametwaa kila kitu kilichokuwa cha mfalme wa Misri, tangu Kijito cha Misri mpaka mto Frati.

vi.B: Vua Ai Cập không còn kéo quân ra khỏi xứ mình nữa, vì vua Ba-by-lôn đã chiếm mọi đất từng thuộc về vua Ai Cập, từ khe Ai Cập đến sông Ơ-phơ-rát.
vi.R: Vua Ai Cập không bao giờ còn dẫn quân ra khỏi nước mình nữa. Vua Ba-by-lôn đã chiếm hết đất đai vua Ai Cập từng cai trị, từ khe Ai Cập ở phía nam đến sông Ơ-phơ-rát ở phía bắc.

ko.L: 그리고 이집트 왕이 다시는 자기 땅에서 나오지 못했다. 바빌론 왕이 이집트 시내에서 유프라테스 강까지 이집트 왕에게 속했던 모든 것을 차지했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이집트 왕은 다시는 자기 나라 밖으로 출병하지 못했다. 바빌론 왕이 이집트 시내에서 유프라테스 강까지 이집트 왕에게 속했던 땅을 모두 차지했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 이집트 왕은 다시는 자기 나라 밖으로 군대를 이끌고 나오지 못했다. 바빌론 왕이 남쪽 이집트 시내에서 북쪽 유프라테스 강까지 이집트 왕이 다스리던 땅을 모두 빼앗았기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: the king of Egypt did not come out again: Egypt no longer campaigned in the region
decisions.reason: Pharaoh Neco had marched to the Euphrates, killed Josiah and set Judah's kings on and off the throne (23:29-35). After Babylon's victory at Carchemish (Jeremiah 46:2) Egypt kept its army at home, so Jehoiakim's rebellion (verse 1) had no ally to rely on.

decisions.choice: from the Wadi of Egypt to the river Euphrates: the whole land between Egypt and Mesopotamia
decisions.reason: The Wadi of Egypt is the dry stream bed at the southwest edge of Canaan (1 Kings 8:65), and the Euphrates the great river to the north-east. These were also the limits of Solomon's rule (1 Kings 5:1; 8:65), and now all of it was Babylon's.

decisions.choice: for ... had taken: the reason Egypt stayed home
decisions.reason: The second clause explains the first: Babylon had already taken the territory, so Egypt had nothing left to march into. The verb points to a past action completed before Jehoiakim's death.

decisions.choice: march out (Balanced); led his army out (Readable); Wadi of Egypt
decisions.reason: "Come out" here means to go out to war, and Balanced and Readable say so. "Wadi of Egypt" is kept as in 1 Kings 8:65, a wadi being a stream bed that is dry except in the rainy season; Readable adds "in the south" and "in the north" to show the span of the land.

decisions.choice: "el torrente de Egipto"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish name of the Wadi of Egypt, kept at every level as the English keeps "Wadi of Egypt".

source.text: בֶּן־שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּ֥א בַת־אֶלְנָתָ֖ן מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] son of eighteen year[s] [was] Jehoiachin when he became king, and three months he reigned in Jerusalem, and [the] name of his mother [was] Nehushta daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem.

en.L: A son of eighteen years [was] Jehoiachin when he became king, and three months he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother [was] Nehushta daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem.
en.B: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem.
en.R: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for three months. His mother was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem.

es.L: Hijo de dieciocho años [era] Joaquín cuando comenzó a reinar, y tres meses reinó en Jerusalén; y el nombre de su madre [era] Nehusta hija de Elnatán, de Jerusalén.
es.B: Joaquín tenía dieciocho años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó tres meses en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Nehusta hija de Elnatán, de Jerusalén.
es.R: Joaquín tenía dieciocho años cuando llegó a ser rey. Gobernó en Jerusalén durante tres meses. Su madre se llamaba Nehusta y era hija de Elnatán, de Jerusalén.

fr.L: Joïakin avait dix-huit ans quand il devint roi, et il régna trois mois à Jérusalem ; et le nom de sa mère [était] Nehoushta fille d’Elnathan, de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Joïakin avait dix-huit ans quand il devint roi, et il régna trois mois à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Nehoushta, fille d’Elnathan, de Jérusalem.
fr.R: Joïakin avait dix-huit ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant trois mois. Sa mère s’appelait Nehoushta ; c’était la fille d’Elnathan, de Jérusalem.

sw.L: Yehoyakini [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka kumi na minane alipoanza kutawala, na miezi mitatu alitawala huko Yerusalemu; na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Nehushta binti Elnathani wa Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Yehoyakini alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na minane alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miezi mitatu huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Nehushta binti Elnathani wa Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Yehoyakini alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na minane alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miezi mitatu. Mama yake aliitwa Nehushta binti Elnathani wa Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Giê-hô-gia-kin [được] mười tám tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì ba tháng tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ ông [là] Nê-hu-ta con gái Ên-na-than, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Giê-hô-gia-kin được mười tám tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì ba tháng tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Nê-hu-ta con gái Ên-na-than, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Giê-hô-gia-kin được mười tám tuổi khi lên làm vua. Ông cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem ba tháng. Mẹ vua tên là Nê-hu-ta, con gái Ên-na-than, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 여호야긴이 왕이 되었을 때 십팔 세[였고], 예루살렘에서 석 달 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 예루살렘 출신 엘라단의 딸 느후스다였다.
ko.B: 여호야긴은 십팔 세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 석 달 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 예루살렘 출신 엘라단의 딸 느후스다였다.
ko.R: 여호야긴은 열여덟 살에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 석 달 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 예루살렘 출신 엘라단의 딸 느후스다였다.

decisions.choice: a son of eighteen years: eighteen years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being the son of so many years (12:1).

decisions.choice: eighteen years old, three months: 2 Chronicles 36:9 has eight years, and adds ten days
decisions.reason: 2 Chronicles 36:9 says Jehoiachin was eight years old and reigned three months and ten days. Kings says eighteen, and the mention of his wives in verse 15 fits the older age. The figure in Chronicles may come from a copying slip; some ancient translations of Chronicles have eighteen.

decisions.choice: Nehushta: the queen mother, who shared his fate
decisions.reason: For the kings of Judah the formula names the king's mother, who held a place of her own at court. Nehushta surrendered and went into exile with her son (verses 12, 15; Jeremiah 13:18; 22:26). Her father Elnathan may be the Elnathan son of Achbor who served Jehoiakim (Jeremiah 26:22; 36:12), but the text does not say so.

decisions.choice: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the age as English does and put the name first; Literal keeps the Hebrew order and idiom.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, according to all that had done his father.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, according to all that his father had done.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as his father had done.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil, just as his father had done.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, conforme a todo lo que había hecho su padre.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tal como lo había hecho su padre.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, tal como lo había hecho su padre.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon tout ce qu’avait fait son père.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, tout comme son père.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais, comme son père l’avait fait.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sawasawa na yote aliyoyafanya baba yake.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama baba yake alivyofanya.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya, kama baba yake alivyofanya.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo mọi điều cha ông đã làm.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như cha ông đã làm.
vi.R: Ông làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, như cha ông đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그의 아버지가 한 모든 일대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 아버지가 한 그대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 아버지처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다.

decisions.choice: the verdict on the king: he followed his father Jehoiakim
decisions.reason: Kings judges every king by his faithfulness to Yahweh. Jehoiachin is given the same verdict as his father (23:37). His reign was too short for the writer to name particular deeds.

decisions.choice: the verdict formula
decisions.reason: The fixed wording for this formula at each level: "did the evil in [the] eyes of", "did what was evil in the sight of", "did what the LORD said was evil".

decisions.choice: "hizo lo malo a los ojos del SEÑOR" (L, B); "hizo lo que el SEÑOR reprueba" (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict formula keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets it.

source.text: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא עָל֗וּ עַבְדֵ֛י נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַתָּבֹ֥א הָעִ֖יר בַּמָּצֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: At the time the that went up [the] servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon [to] Jerusalem, and came the city into the siege.

en.L: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon went up [to] Jerusalem, and the city came into siege.
en.B: At that time the officers of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon advanced on Jerusalem, and the city came under siege.
en.R: At that time the officers of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem. They surrounded the city and attacked it.

es.L: En aquel tiempo subieron los siervos de Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, [a] Jerusalén, y la ciudad fue sitiada.
es.B: En aquel tiempo los oficiales de Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, avanzaron contra Jerusalén, y la ciudad quedó sitiada.
es.R: En aquel tiempo los oficiales de Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, marcharon contra Jerusalén. Rodearon la ciudad y la atacaron.

fr.L: En ce temps-là, les serviteurs de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, montèrent [contre] Jérusalem, et la ville fut assiégée.
fr.B: En ce temps-là, les officiers de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, marchèrent contre Jérusalem, et la ville fut assiégée.
fr.R: À cette époque, les officiers de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, ont attaqué Jérusalem. Ils ont encerclé la ville et l’ont assiégée.

sw.L: Wakati huo watumishi wa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli walipanda [hata] Yerusalemu, nao mji ukazingirwa.
sw.B: Wakati huo maafisa wa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli walipanda kuishambulia Yerusalemu, na mji ukazingirwa.
sw.R: Wakati huo maafisa wa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli walikwenda kuishambulia Yerusalemu. Wakauzunguka mji na kuushambulia.

vi.L: Lúc ấy các đầy tớ của Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn đi lên Giê-ru-sa-lem, và thành bị vây hãm.
vi.B: Lúc ấy các tướng của Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn tiến đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem, và thành bị vây hãm.
vi.R: Lúc ấy các tướng của Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn kéo quân đến đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ vây thành và tấn công.

ko.L: 그때에 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살의 신하들이 예루살렘으로 올라왔고, 그 성이 포위되었다.
ko.B: 그때에 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살의 장수들이 예루살렘으로 쳐올라왔고, 그 성은 포위되었다.
ko.R: 그때에 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살의 장수들이 예루살렘을 치러 왔다. 그들은 성을 에워싸고 공격했다.

decisions.choice: went up: the plural form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) have the singular "he went up"; the scribes marked the plural "they went up" to be read aloud (qere), agreeing with "the servants". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: the servants of Nebuchadnezzar: his officers and the troops under them
decisions.reason: A king's servants are the men who act for him. Here they are his army commanders, who began the siege before the king himself arrived (verse 11).

decisions.choice: the city came into siege: Jerusalem was surrounded and cut off
decisions.reason: To come into siege is to be shut in by an enemy army camped around the walls, so that no one can go in or out and food runs short.

decisions.choice: officers
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "servants". For a king's men acting for him, Balanced and Readable may say "officials"; here they lead an army, so both say "officers". Readable says what the siege meant in two plain verbs.

decisions.choice: "oficiales"
decisions.reason: The king's servants acting for him in war are "oficiales" at Balanced and Readable, as the Samuel terms note sets; Literal keeps "siervos".

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֛א נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל עַל־הָעִ֑יר וַעֲבָדָ֖יו צָרִ֥ים עָלֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon against the city, and his servants [were] besieging it.

en.L: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, while his servants were besieging it.
en.B: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city himself while his officers were besieging it.
en.R: Then Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city himself while his officers were attacking it.

es.L: Y vino Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, contra la ciudad, mientras sus siervos la sitiaban.
es.B: Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, vino en persona a la ciudad mientras sus oficiales la sitiaban.
es.R: Luego Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, llegó en persona a la ciudad mientras sus oficiales la atacaban.

fr.L: Et Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, vint contre la ville, pendant que ses serviteurs l’assiégeaient.
fr.B: Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, vint lui-même devant la ville pendant que ses officiers l’assiégeaient.
fr.R: Ensuite Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, est venu lui-même devant la ville pendant que ses officiers l’attaquaient.

sw.L: Naye Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli akaja juu ya mji, watumishi wake walipokuwa wakiuzingira.
sw.B: Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli alikuja mwenyewe kwenye mji maafisa wake walipokuwa wakiuzingira.
sw.R: Kisha Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli alikuja mwenyewe kwenye mji maafisa wake walipokuwa wakiushambulia.

vi.L: Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn đến đánh thành, trong khi các đầy tớ của vua đang vây hãm thành.
vi.B: Chính Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn cũng đến thành trong khi các tướng của vua đang vây hãm thành.
vi.R: Rồi chính Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn cũng đến thành trong khi các tướng của vua đang tấn công thành.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 신하들이 그 성을 에워싸고 있을 때에 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 그 성에 왔다.
ko.B: 그의 장수들이 그 성을 포위하고 있을 때에 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 몸소 그 성으로 왔다.
ko.R: 그의 장수들이 성을 공격하고 있을 때에 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 직접 그 성으로 왔다.

decisions.choice: his servants besieging it: what was going on when the king arrived
decisions.reason: The second clause uses a participle with no main verb: the siege was already in progress, and the king came to it. The king's coming marks the decisive stage of the siege.

decisions.choice: himself; officers
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "himself" to bring out the contrast with his officers in verse 10, and keep "officers" as in verse 10.

source.text: וַיֵּצֵ֞א יְהוֹיָכִ֤ין מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה֙ עַל־מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל ה֣וּא וְאִמּ֔וֹ וַעֲבָדָ֖יו וְשָׂרָ֣יו וְסָֽרִיסָ֑יו וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁמֹנֶ֖ה לְמָלְכֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out Jehoiachin king of Judah to [the] king of Babylon, he and his mother and his servants and his princes and his eunuchs; and took him [the] king of Babylon in [the] year eight of his reigning.

en.L: And Jehoiachin king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he and his mother and his servants and his princes and his eunuchs; and the king of Babylon took him in [the] eighth year of his reign.
en.B: Jehoiachin king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon in surrender, he and his mother, his servants, his officials and his court officers. The king of Babylon took him prisoner in the eighth year of his reign.
en.R: Jehoiachin king of Judah surrendered to the king of Babylon. He went out to him with his mother, his servants, his leaders and his palace officials. The king of Babylon took him prisoner. It was the eighth year that Nebuchadnezzar had been king.

es.L: Y salió Joaquín, rey de Judá, al rey de Babilonia, él y su madre, y sus siervos, y sus príncipes y sus eunucos; y el rey de Babilonia lo tomó en el año octavo de su reinado.
es.B: Joaquín, rey de Judá, salió a rendirse ante el rey de Babilonia, junto con su madre, sus siervos, sus funcionarios y los oficiales de su corte. El rey de Babilonia lo tomó prisionero en el octavo año de su reinado.
es.R: Joaquín, rey de Judá, se rindió ante el rey de Babilonia. Salió a su encuentro con su madre, sus siervos, sus jefes y los funcionarios de su palacio. El rey de Babilonia lo tomó prisionero. Era el octavo año del reinado de Nabucodonosor.

fr.L: Et Joïakin, roi de Juda, sortit vers le roi de Babylone, lui, sa mère, ses serviteurs, ses princes et ses eunuques ; et le roi de Babylone le prit en la huitième année de son règne.
fr.B: Joïakin, roi de Juda, se rendit au roi de Babylone, avec sa mère, ses serviteurs, ses chefs et ses hauts fonctionnaires. Le roi de Babylone le fit prisonnier la huitième année de son règne.
fr.R: Joïakin, roi de Juda, s’est rendu au roi de Babylone. Il est sorti vers lui avec sa mère, ses serviteurs, ses chefs et les fonctionnaires du palais. Le roi de Babylone l’a fait prisonnier. C’était la huitième année du règne de Nabuchodonosor.

sw.L: Naye Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda akatoka kwenda kwa mfalme wa Babeli, yeye na mama yake na watumishi wake na wakuu wake na matowashi wake; naye mfalme wa Babeli akamchukua katika mwaka wa nane wa kutawala kwake.
sw.B: Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda alitoka kwenda kujisalimisha kwa mfalme wa Babeli, yeye na mama yake, watumishi wake, maafisa wake na wakuu wa ikulu yake. Mfalme wa Babeli akamchukua mateka katika mwaka wa nane wa utawala wake.
sw.R: Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda alijisalimisha kwa mfalme wa Babeli. Alitoka kwenda kwake pamoja na mama yake, watumishi wake, viongozi wake na maafisa wa jumba lake. Mfalme wa Babeli akamchukua mateka. Ilikuwa katika mwaka wa nane wa utawala wa Nebukadneza.

vi.L: Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa đi ra đến vua Ba-by-lôn, ông cùng mẹ ông, các đầy tớ, các thủ lĩnh và các hoạn quan của ông; vua Ba-by-lôn bắt ông vào năm thứ tám đời trị vì của vua ấy.
vi.B: Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa ra đầu hàng vua Ba-by-lôn, cùng với mẹ vua, các đầy tớ, các quan chức và các triều thần của vua. Vua Ba-by-lôn bắt Giê-hô-gia-kin làm tù binh vào năm thứ tám đời trị vì của mình.
vi.R: Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa đầu hàng vua Ba-by-lôn. Ông ra gặp vua ấy cùng với mẹ mình, các đầy tớ, các thủ lĩnh và các quan chức trong cung. Vua Ba-by-lôn bắt ông làm tù binh. Lúc ấy là năm thứ tám đời Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa làm vua.

ko.L: 그리고 유다 왕 여호야긴이 그와 그의 어머니와 그의 신하들과 그의 고관들과 그의 내시들과 함께 바빌론 왕에게 나갔다. 그리고 바빌론 왕이 그의 통치 제팔년에 그를 사로잡았다.
ko.B: 유다 왕 여호야긴은 그의 어머니와 신하들과 고관들과 관리들과 함께 바빌론 왕에게 나가 항복했다. 바빌론 왕은 자기가 다스린 지 팔 년째 되는 해에 그를 사로잡았다.
ko.R: 유다 왕 여호야긴은 바빌론 왕에게 항복했다. 그는 자기 어머니와 신하들과 지도자들과 왕궁 관리들을 데리고 바빌론 왕에게 나갔다. 바빌론 왕은 그를 포로로 잡았다. 그때는 느부갓네살이 왕이 된 지 팔 년째 되는 해였다.

decisions.choice: went out to the king of Babylon: surrendered
decisions.reason: To go out of a besieged city to the enemy king is to give oneself up to him (18:31; 1 Samuel 11:3). Jehoiachin came out with his whole court.

decisions.choice: eunuchs: royal officials, perhaps castrated men
decisions.reason: The word names a class of court officers. Many of them in the courts of the ancient Near East were castrated, but the word is also used of high officials who were not, so it may simply mean "palace officials" here.

decisions.choice: the eighth year of his reign: Nebuchadnezzar's eighth year, 597 BC
decisions.reason: "His" is the king of Babylon. Babylon's own records of the period date the capture of Jerusalem to early 597 BC. Jeremiah 52:28 dates a deportation to Nebuchadnezzar's seventh year; that list may count the years from a different starting point, or describe another group.

decisions.choice: took him: the start of Jehoiachin's long captivity
decisions.reason: Jehoiachin stayed a prisoner in Babylon for thirty-seven years, until a later king of Babylon released him (25:27-30).

decisions.choice: servants, princes, eunuchs (Literal); servants, officials, court officers (Balanced); servants, leaders, palace officials (Readable)
decisions.reason: Three words for the king's court stand side by side here. Literal follows the usual wording for each. Balanced uses "officials" for the princes as usual, so it calls the eunuchs "court officers" to keep the three groups apart; Readable has "leaders" for the princes and "palace officials" for the eunuchs.

decisions.choice: in surrender; took him prisoner
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what going out to the enemy and being taken meant. Readable names Nebuchadnezzar so that "his reign" is clear.

decisions.choice: "siervos, príncipes, eunucos" (L); "siervos, funcionarios, oficiales de su corte" (B); "siervos, jefes, funcionarios de su palacio" (R)
decisions.reason: Three words for the king's court stand side by side; each level keeps them apart as the English does, with "eunucos" at Literal as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "eunuques" (L); "hauts fonctionnaires" (B); "fonctionnaires du palais" (R)
decisions.reason: *Sarisim* as the terms note sets for royal officials (m2).

decisions.choice: watumishi, wakuu, matowashi (Literal); watumishi, maafisa, wakuu wa ikulu (Balanced); watumishi, viongozi, maafisa wa jumba (Readable)
decisions.reason: The court in the terms note's wording: *sarisim* are "matowashi" at Literal and court officials at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: וַיּוֹצֵ֣א מִשָּׁ֗ם אֶת־כָּל־אוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְאֽוֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיְקַצֵּ֞ץ אֶת־כָּל־כְּלֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought out from there all [the] treasures of [the] house of Yahweh and [the] treasures of [the] house of the king, and he cut up all [the] vessels of the gold which had made Solomon king of Israel in [the] temple of Yahweh, as had spoken Yahweh.

en.L: And he brought out from there all the treasures of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the treasures of the house of the king, and he cut up all the vessels of gold that Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken.
en.B: He carried off from there all the treasures of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and those of the king's palace, and he cut up all the gold vessels that Solomon king of Israel had made for the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said.
en.R: Nebuchadnezzar took away all the treasures from the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and from the king's palace. He cut into pieces all the gold objects that Solomon king of Israel had made for the temple. This was just what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said would happen.

es.L: Y sacó de allí todos los tesoros de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los tesoros de la casa del rey, y despedazó todos los utensilios de oro que había hecho Salomón, rey de Israel, en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho.
es.B: Se llevó de allí todos los tesoros de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los del palacio real, y despedazó todos los utensilios de oro que Salomón, rey de Israel, había hecho para el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había anunciado.
es.R: Nabucodonosor se llevó todos los tesoros del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y del palacio real. Hizo pedazos todos los objetos de oro que Salomón, rey de Israel, había hecho para el templo. Así sucedió lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho que pasaría.

fr.L: Et il emporta de là tous les trésors de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et les trésors de la maison du roi, et il mit en pièces tous les objets d’or qu’avait faits Salomon, roi d’Israël, dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait dit.
fr.B: Il emporta de là tous les trésors de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et ceux du palais royal, et il mit en pièces tous les objets d’or que Salomon, roi d’Israël, avait faits pour le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait annoncé.
fr.R: Nabuchodonosor a emporté tous les trésors du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et du palais du roi. Il a cassé en morceaux tous les objets en or que Salomon, roi d’Israël, avait fabriqués pour le temple. C’est exactement ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait annoncé.

sw.L: Naye akatoa huko hazina zote za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na hazina za nyumba ya mfalme, akavikatakata vyombo vyote vya dhahabu ambavyo Sulemani mfalme wa Israeli alikuwa amevifanya katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amesema.
sw.B: Akachukua kutoka huko hazina zote za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na za ikulu, akavikatakata vyombo vyote vya dhahabu ambavyo Sulemani mfalme wa Israeli alikuwa amevifanya kwa ajili ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amesema.
sw.R: Nebukadneza alichukua hazina zote za hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na za jumba la mfalme. Akavikata vipande vipande vyombo vyote vya dhahabu ambavyo Sulemani mfalme wa Israeli alikuwa amevitengeneza kwa ajili ya hekalu. Hivyo ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amesema itakavyotokea.

vi.L: Vua ấy đem ra khỏi đó mọi báu vật của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và báu vật của cung vua, và chặt vụn mọi khí cụ bằng vàng mà Sa-lô-môn vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã làm trong đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.B: Vua ấy lấy đi khỏi đó mọi báu vật của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và của hoàng cung, và chặt vụn mọi khí cụ bằng vàng mà Sa-lô-môn vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã làm cho đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.R: Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa lấy đi mọi báu vật trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong hoàng cung. Vua ấy chặt vụn mọi đồ vật bằng vàng mà Sa-lô-môn vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã làm cho đền thờ. Việc này xảy ra đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã báo trước.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 거기에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 모든 보물과 왕의 집의 보물을 가져가고, 이스라엘 왕 솔로몬이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 만들어 둔 모든 금 그릇을 잘랐다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로였다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 모든 보물과 왕궁의 보물을 거기에서 가져갔다. 그는 이스라엘 왕 솔로몬이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 위해 만든 금 그릇들을 모두 깨뜨렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 그대로였다.
ko.R: 느부갓네살은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전과 왕궁에서 보물을 모두 가져갔다. 그는 이스라엘 왕 솔로몬이 성전을 위해 만든 금 그릇들을 모두 조각냈다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 일어날 것이라고 말씀하신 그대로였다.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh had spoken: through Isaiah to Hezekiah
decisions.reason: Isaiah had told Hezekiah that everything in his palace and all his ancestors had stored up would be carried off to Babylon (20:17). Temple treasure had been handed over before to buy off enemies (12:19; 18:15-16) and seized in war (14:14), but now Babylon took it all.

decisions.choice: cut up: broke the gold vessels into pieces or stripped off their gold
decisions.reason: The verb means to cut off or cut into pieces. It was used when Hezekiah stripped the gold from the temple doors (18:16). The gold was taken as metal, not kept as vessels. Some of Solomon's bronze furnishings were left until the city's fall (25:13-17).

decisions.choice: the vessels of gold that Solomon had made
decisions.reason: Solomon's gold furnishings for the temple are listed in 1 Kings 7:48-51.

decisions.choice: Nebuchadnezzar
decisions.reason: Readable names the king for "he", and leaves out the second "of the LORD" after "temple", which is clear from the first.

source.text: וְהִגְלָ֣ה אֶת־כָּל־יְ֠רוּשָׁלִַם וְֽאֶת־כָּל־הַשָּׂרִ֞ים וְאֵ֣ת׀כָּל־גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל עֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ גּוֹלֶ֔ה וְכָל־הֶחָרָ֖שׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּ֑ר לֹ֣א נִשְׁאַ֔ר זוּלַ֖ת דַּלַּ֥ת עַם־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he exiled all Jerusalem and all the princes and all [the] mighty [men] of the valor, ten thousand exiles, and every craftsman and the smith; not was left except [the] poorest of [the] people of the land.

en.L: And he exiled all Jerusalem and all the princes and all the mighty men of valor, 10,000 exiles, and every craftsman and smith; none was left except the poorest of the people of the land.
en.B: He carried all Jerusalem into exile: all the officials and all the mighty warriors, 10,000 captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths. No one was left except the poorest people of the land.
en.R: He took the people of Jerusalem away as captives. He took all the leaders and all the best soldiers, 10,000 people in all, and all the skilled workers and metalworkers. Only the poorest people in the land were left.

es.L: Y llevó cautiva a toda Jerusalén, y a todos los príncipes y a todos los valientes guerreros, diez mil cautivos, y a todos los artesanos y herreros; no quedó nadie excepto los más pobres del pueblo de la tierra.
es.B: Llevó al destierro a toda Jerusalén: a todos los funcionarios y a todos los guerreros valientes, diez mil cautivos, y a todos los artesanos y herreros. No quedó nadie sino la gente más pobre del país.
es.R: Se llevó como prisioneros a la gente de Jerusalén. Se llevó a todos los jefes y a los mejores soldados, diez mil personas en total, y a todos los artesanos y los que trabajaban el metal. Solo quedó la gente más pobre del país.

fr.L: Et il déporta tout Jérusalem, tous les princes et tous les vaillants guerriers, dix mille déportés, et tous les artisans et les forgerons ; il ne resta que les plus pauvres du peuple du pays.
fr.B: Il emmena en exil tout Jérusalem : tous les chefs et tous les vaillants guerriers, dix mille captifs, ainsi que tous les artisans et les forgerons. Il ne resta que la population la plus pauvre du pays.
fr.R: Il a emmené les gens de Jérusalem comme prisonniers. Il a emmené tous les chefs et tous les meilleurs soldats, dix mille personnes en tout, et tous les artisans et ceux qui travaillaient les métaux. Il n’est resté que les gens les plus pauvres du pays.

sw.L: Naye akawahamisha Yerusalemu wote, na wakuu wote na mashujaa wote wa vita, mateka 10,000, na kila fundi na mhunzi; hakubaki mtu ila maskini kabisa wa watu wa nchi.
sw.B: Aliwachukua uhamishoni Yerusalemu wote: maafisa wote na mashujaa wote wa vita, mateka 10,000, na mafundi wote na wahunzi. Hakubaki mtu ila watu maskini kabisa wa nchi.
sw.R: Aliwachukua mateka watu wa Yerusalemu. Aliwachukua viongozi wote na askari wote hodari, watu 10,000 kwa jumla, na mafundi wote stadi na wahunzi. Ni watu maskini kabisa wa nchi tu waliobaki.

vi.L: Vua ấy bắt cả Giê-ru-sa-lem lưu đày, mọi thủ lĩnh và mọi dũng sĩ, mười nghìn người lưu đày, cùng mọi thợ thủ công và thợ rèn; không còn ai sót lại ngoài những người nghèo nhất trong dân của xứ.
vi.B: Vua ấy bắt cả Giê-ru-sa-lem đi lưu đày: mọi quan chức và mọi chiến sĩ dũng mãnh, mười nghìn người bị bắt, cùng mọi thợ thủ công và thợ rèn. Không còn ai ở lại ngoài những người nghèo nhất trong xứ.
vi.R: Vua ấy bắt dân Giê-ru-sa-lem đi làm tù binh. Vua bắt mọi thủ lĩnh và mọi binh sĩ giỏi nhất, tổng cộng mười nghìn người, cùng mọi thợ lành nghề và thợ kim loại. Chỉ còn những người nghèo nhất trong xứ ở lại.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 온 예루살렘과 모든 고관과 모든 용사, 곧 포로 만 명과 모든 장인과 대장장이를 사로잡아 갔다. 그 땅 백성 가운데 가장 가난한 자들 외에는 남은 자가 없었다.
ko.B: 그는 예루살렘의 모든 사람, 곧 모든 고관과 모든 용사를 사로잡아 갔는데, 포로가 만 명이었다. 모든 장인과 대장장이도 끌려갔다. 그 땅에서 가장 가난한 백성 외에는 아무도 남지 않았다.
ko.R: 그는 예루살렘 사람들을 포로로 잡아갔다. 모든 지도자와 가장 뛰어난 군인들, 모두 만 명을 데려갔다. 기술자들과 쇠붙이를 다루는 사람들도 모두 데려갔다. 그 땅에는 가장 가난한 사람들만 남았다.

decisions.choice: ten: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) have a different form of the number ten; the scribes marked the usual form to be read aloud (qere). The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: all Jerusalem: the city's leading people, not every person
decisions.reason: The verse itself says the poorest were left, and Jerusalem still had a king and people under Zedekiah (verses 17-20; 25:11). "All Jerusalem" means the city as a community, and the lists that follow say who was taken.

decisions.choice: smith: a metalworker, though the exact trade is uncertain
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning "to shut" or "to close". It may name smiths, makers of locks and fittings, or men who built or held fortifications. Taking away the craftsmen left Judah unable to make weapons or repair its walls.

decisions.choice: ten thousand exiles: a total, probably counted with the groups of verse 16
decisions.reason: Verse 16 counts seven thousand fighting men and a thousand craftsmen. The ten thousand here may include them, together with the officials and the court, or the two verses may give two separate counts. Jeremiah 52:28 gives 3,023 people of Judah taken in Nebuchadnezzar's seventh year, perhaps counting only one group.

decisions.choice: the poorest of the people of the land
decisions.reason: Those left were the poor who had no land, rank or skill that mattered to Babylon. The same happened after the city's fall (25:12).

decisions.choice: officials, mighty warriors (Balanced); leaders, best soldiers (Readable)
decisions.reason: The princes are "officials" at Balanced and "leaders" at Readable, as in these books. "Mighty men of valor" are fighting men known for their strength and courage; Balanced says "mighty warriors" and Readable "best soldiers".

source.text: וַיֶּ֥גֶל אֶת־יְהוֹיָכִ֖ין בָּבֶ֑לָה וְאֶת־אֵ֣ם הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וְאֶת־סָרִיסָ֗יו וְאֵת֙ אֵילֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ הוֹלִ֛יךְ גּוֹלָ֥ה מִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he exiled Jehoiachin to Babylon, and [the] mother of the king and [the] wives of the king and his eunuchs and [the] leaders of the land he led [into] exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.

en.L: And he exiled Jehoiachin to Babylon; and the mother of the king and the wives of the king and his eunuchs and the leading men of the land he led away [into] exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
en.B: He carried Jehoiachin into exile to Babylon. The king's mother, the king's wives, his court officers and the leading men of the land he also took into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
en.R: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin to Babylon as a captive. He also took the king's mother, his wives, his palace officials and the most important men of the land. He carried them all away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

es.L: Y llevó cautivo a Joaquín a Babilonia; y a la madre del rey, y a las mujeres del rey, y a sus eunucos y a los poderosos de la tierra los llevó cautivos de Jerusalén a Babilonia.
es.B: Llevó a Joaquín al destierro en Babilonia. También llevó al destierro, de Jerusalén a Babilonia, a la madre del rey, a las esposas del rey, a los oficiales de su corte y a los hombres principales del país.
es.R: Nabucodonosor se llevó a Joaquín a Babilonia como prisionero. También se llevó a la madre del rey, a sus esposas, a los funcionarios de su palacio y a los hombres más importantes del país. Se los llevó a todos de Jerusalén a Babilonia.

fr.L: Et il déporta Joïakin à Babylone ; et la mère du roi, les femmes du roi, ses eunuques et les notables du pays, il les emmena en exil de Jérusalem à Babylone.
fr.B: Il emmena Joïakin en exil à Babylone. La mère du roi, les femmes du roi, ses hauts fonctionnaires et les notables du pays, il les emmena aussi en exil de Jérusalem à Babylone.
fr.R: Nabuchodonosor a emmené Joïakin à Babylone comme prisonnier. Il a aussi emmené la mère du roi, ses femmes, les fonctionnaires du palais et les hommes les plus importants du pays. Il les a tous emmenés de Jérusalem à Babylone.

sw.L: Naye akamhamisha Yehoyakini mpaka Babeli; na mama wa mfalme na wake za mfalme na matowashi wake na wakuu wa nchi akawapeleka uhamishoni kutoka Yerusalemu mpaka Babeli.
sw.B: Alimchukua Yehoyakini uhamishoni mpaka Babeli. Mama wa mfalme, wake za mfalme, wakuu wa ikulu yake na watu mashuhuri wa nchi pia aliwachukua uhamishoni kutoka Yerusalemu mpaka Babeli.
sw.R: Nebukadneza alimchukua Yehoyakini mpaka Babeli akiwa mateka. Aliwachukua pia mama wa mfalme, wake zake, maafisa wa jumba lake na watu muhimu kabisa wa nchi. Aliwachukua wote kutoka Yerusalemu mpaka Babeli.

vi.L: Vua ấy bắt Giê-hô-gia-kin lưu đày sang Ba-by-lôn; mẹ vua, các vợ vua, các hoạn quan của vua và những người quyền thế trong xứ, vua ấy dẫn đi lưu đày từ Giê-ru-sa-lem sang Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Vua ấy bắt Giê-hô-gia-kin lưu đày sang Ba-by-lôn. Mẹ vua, các vợ vua, các triều thần và những người quyền thế trong xứ cũng bị vua ấy bắt đi lưu đày từ Giê-ru-sa-lem sang Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa bắt Giê-hô-gia-kin đem sang Ba-by-lôn làm tù binh. Vua ấy cũng bắt mẹ vua, các vợ vua, các quan chức trong cung và những người quan trọng nhất trong xứ. Vua ấy đem tất cả họ từ Giê-ru-sa-lem sang Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 여호야긴을 바빌론으로 사로잡아 갔다. 그리고 왕의 어머니와 왕의 아내들과 그의 내시들과 그 땅의 유력자들을 예루살렘에서 바빌론으로 포로로 끌고 갔다.
ko.B: 그는 여호야긴을 바빌론으로 사로잡아 갔다. 왕의 어머니와 왕의 아내들과 그의 관리들과 그 땅의 유력자들도 예루살렘에서 바빌론으로 포로로 끌고 갔다.
ko.R: 느부갓네살은 여호야긴을 포로로 잡아 바빌론으로 데려갔다. 그는 왕의 어머니와 왕의 아내들과 왕궁 관리들과 그 땅의 가장 중요한 사람들도 데려갔다. 그는 그들을 모두 예루살렘에서 바빌론으로 끌고 갔다.

decisions.choice: the leading men: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) spell the word differently; the scribes marked this form to be read aloud (qere). Both name the powerful men of the land.

decisions.choice: the leading men of the land: its powerful and wealthy men
decisions.reason: The word can mean rams, the strong leaders of a flock, and is used of chiefs and nobles (Exodus 15:15; Ezekiel 17:13). With the court, they made up Judah's ruling class.

decisions.choice: he exiled Jehoiachin to Babylon
decisions.reason: Jeremiah had said that Coniah (Jehoiachin) and his mother would be thrown into a land where they were not born (Jeremiah 22:24-27). His letter to the exiles names this same group: the king, the queen mother, the court officials and the princes (Jeremiah 29:2). Ezekiel was among those taken, and dated his book by this exile (Ezekiel 1:2).

decisions.choice: court officers (Balanced); palace officials (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 12. Readable says "most important men" for the leading men of the land and names Nebuchadnezzar for "he".

source.text: וְאֵת֩ כָּל־אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַחַ֜יִל שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֗ים וְהֶחָרָ֤שׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר֙ אֶ֔לֶף הַכֹּ֕ל גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים עֹשֵׂ֣י מִלְחָמָ֑ה וַיְבִיאֵ֧ם מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל גּוֹלָ֖ה בָּבֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And all [the] men of the valor, seven thousand, and the craftsman and the smith, a thousand, the all [were] mighty, makers of war, and brought them [the] king of Babylon [as] exiles to Babylon.

en.L: And all the men of valor, 7,000, and the craftsmen and the smiths, a thousand, all [of them] mighty, makers of war, the king of Babylon brought them [as] exiles to Babylon.
en.B: The king of Babylon brought to Babylon as exiles all the men of valor, 7,000, and the craftsmen and smiths, a thousand, all of them strong men fit for war.
en.R: The king of Babylon also took to Babylon as captives 7,000 of the best fighting men and a thousand skilled workers and metalworkers. All of them were strong and able to fight.

es.L: Y a todos los hombres valientes, siete mil, y a los artesanos y herreros, mil, todos ellos fuertes y aptos para la guerra, el rey de Babilonia los llevó cautivos a Babilonia.
es.B: El rey de Babilonia llevó cautivos a Babilonia a todos los hombres valientes, siete mil, y a los artesanos y herreros, mil, todos ellos hombres fuertes y aptos para la guerra.
es.R: El rey de Babilonia también se llevó como prisioneros a Babilonia a siete mil de los mejores soldados y a mil artesanos y trabajadores del metal. Todos eran fuertes y capaces de pelear.

fr.L: Et tous les hommes vaillants, sept mille, et les artisans et les forgerons, mille, tous [étaient] des hommes forts, faisant la guerre ; le roi de Babylone les emmena [comme] déportés à Babylone.
fr.B: Le roi de Babylone emmena en exil à Babylone tous les hommes vaillants, sept mille, ainsi que les artisans et les forgerons, mille, tous des hommes robustes et aptes à la guerre.
fr.R: Le roi de Babylone a aussi emmené à Babylone comme prisonniers sept mille des meilleurs combattants et mille artisans et ouvriers des métaux. Tous étaient forts et capables de combattre.

sw.L: Na mashujaa wote, 7,000, na mafundi na wahunzi, elfu moja, wote [walikuwa] hodari, watu wa vita, mfalme wa Babeli akawaleta [wakiwa] mateka mpaka Babeli.
sw.B: Mfalme wa Babeli aliwaleta Babeli kama mateka mashujaa wote, 7,000, na mafundi na wahunzi, elfu moja, wote wakiwa watu wenye nguvu wanaofaa kwa vita.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Babeli aliwachukua pia mpaka Babeli kama mateka askari hodari 7,000, na mafundi stadi na wahunzi elfu moja. Wote walikuwa na nguvu na waliweza kupigana vita.

vi.L: Mọi dũng sĩ, bảy nghìn người, cùng thợ thủ công và thợ rèn, một nghìn người, tất cả [đều là] người mạnh mẽ, giỏi chiến trận, vua Ba-by-lôn đem họ đi lưu đày sang Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Vua Ba-by-lôn đem sang Ba-by-lôn làm người lưu đày mọi dũng sĩ, bảy nghìn người, cùng thợ thủ công và thợ rèn, một nghìn người, tất cả đều là người mạnh mẽ, có thể ra trận.
vi.R: Vua Ba-by-lôn cũng bắt sang Ba-by-lôn bảy nghìn binh sĩ giỏi nhất và một nghìn thợ lành nghề và thợ kim loại. Tất cả đều khỏe mạnh và có thể ra trận.

ko.L: 그리고 모든 용사 칠천 명과 장인과 대장장이 천 명, 모두 힘센 전사들을 바빌론 왕이 바빌론으로 포로로 끌고 갔다.
ko.B: 바빌론 왕은 용사 칠천 명과 장인과 대장장이 천 명을 포로로 바빌론에 끌고 갔다. 그들은 모두 싸움에 능한 힘센 사람들이었다.
ko.R: 바빌론 왕은 가장 뛰어난 군인 칠천 명과 기술자와 쇠붙이를 다루는 사람 천 명도 포로로 바빌론에 데려갔다. 그들은 모두 힘이 세고 싸울 수 있는 사람들이었다.

decisions.choice: men of valor: able fighting men
decisions.reason: The word for valor also means strength, ability and wealth, and "men of valor" can mean men of standing. Next to "makers of war" it means men able to fight.

decisions.choice: all of them mighty, makers of war: said of the whole group
decisions.reason: The phrase may describe all eight thousand, or only the craftsmen, who were strong men who could also serve in war. Either way, Babylon took the men who could have defended or rebuilt Judah.

decisions.choice: seven thousand ... a thousand: counts within the exile of verse 14
decisions.reason: See verse 14 on how these numbers relate to the ten thousand there.

decisions.choice: the king of Babylon first
decisions.reason: The Hebrew lists the groups first and then says "the king of Babylon brought them". Balanced and Readable start with the king, as English does; Readable keeps "metalworkers" for the smiths as in verse 14.

source.text: וַיַּמְלֵ֧ךְ מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־מַתַּנְיָ֥ה דֹד֖וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑יו וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And made king [the] king of Babylon Mattaniah his uncle in his place, and he changed his name [to] Zedekiah.

en.L: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his uncle king in his place, and he changed his name [to] Zedekiah.
en.B: The king of Babylon made Jehoiachin's uncle Mattaniah king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah.
en.R: The king of Babylon made Jehoiachin's uncle Mattaniah king in his place. He changed Mattaniah's name to Zedekiah.

es.L: Y el rey de Babilonia puso por rey en su lugar a Matanías, tío de él, y le cambió el nombre [por] Sedequías.
es.B: El rey de Babilonia puso como rey en su lugar a Matanías, tío de Joaquín, y le cambió el nombre por el de Sedequías.
es.R: El rey de Babilonia hizo rey en lugar de Joaquín a su tío Matanías. Le cambió el nombre a Matanías y le puso Sedequías.

fr.L: Et le roi de Babylone fit roi Mattania, son oncle, à sa place, et il changea son nom [en] Sédécias.
fr.B: Le roi de Babylone établit roi à sa place Mattania, l’oncle de Joïakin, et il changea son nom en Sédécias.
fr.R: Le roi de Babylone a fait roi Mattania, l’oncle de Joïakin, à sa place. Il a changé le nom de Mattania en Sédécias.

sw.L: Naye mfalme wa Babeli akamtawaza Matania baba yake mdogo kuwa mfalme mahali pake, akabadilisha jina lake [kuwa] Sedekia.
sw.B: Mfalme wa Babeli alimtawaza Matania, baba mdogo wa Yehoyakini, kuwa mfalme mahali pake, akabadilisha jina lake kuwa Sedekia.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Babeli alimfanya Matania, baba mdogo wa Yehoyakini, kuwa mfalme mahali pake. Akabadilisha jina la Matania kuwa Sedekia.

vi.L: Vua Ba-by-lôn lập Mát-ta-nia, chú của ông, làm vua thay ông, và đổi tên ông [thành] Sê-đê-kia.
vi.B: Vua Ba-by-lôn lập Mát-ta-nia, chú của Giê-hô-gia-kin, làm vua thay ông, và đổi tên Mát-ta-nia thành Sê-đê-kia.
vi.R: Vua Ba-by-lôn lập Mát-ta-nia, chú của Giê-hô-gia-kin, làm vua thay ông. Vua ấy đổi tên Mát-ta-nia thành Sê-đê-kia.

ko.L: 그리고 바빌론 왕이 그의 삼촌 맛다니야를 그를 대신하여 왕으로 삼고, 그의 이름을 시드기야로 바꾸었다.
ko.B: 바빌론 왕은 여호야긴의 삼촌 맛다니야를 그 대신 왕으로 세우고, 그의 이름을 시드기야로 바꾸었다.
ko.R: 바빌론 왕은 여호야긴의 삼촌 맛다니야를 그 대신 왕으로 세웠다. 그는 맛다니야의 이름을 시드기야로 바꾸었다.

decisions.choice: his uncle: Jehoiachin's father's brother
decisions.reason: Mattaniah was a son of Josiah and a brother of Jehoiakim (1 Chronicles 3:15; Jeremiah 1:3). 2 Chronicles 36:10 calls him Jehoiachin's "brother", using the word in its wider sense of a male relative.

decisions.choice: he changed his name: a sign of the overlord's power
decisions.reason: Renaming a king showed who had made him king and whom he served, as when Pharaoh Neco renamed Eliakim Jehoiakim (23:34). Mattaniah means "gift of Yahweh"; Zedekiah means "Yahweh is my righteousness" or "Yahweh is righteous". Both names honor Yahweh.

decisions.choice: Mattaniah, Zedekiah
decisions.reason: Each level keeps both names in the data's English forms. Balanced and Readable name Jehoiachin for "his" so it is clear whose uncle Mattaniah was, and Readable names Mattaniah for the second "his".

decisions.choice: "Matanías", "Sedequías"
decisions.reason: "Sedequías" as the terms note's table gives Zedekiah; "Matanías" in its usual Spanish form. Balanced and Readable name Jehoiachin, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Mattania; Sédécias
decisions.reason: Sédécias as the terms note sets; Mattania in the same transcription as the other names.

decisions.choice: baba mdogo
decisions.reason: His father's brother (meaning decision m1) is "baba mdogo" in Swahili, as in 1 Samuel; "mjomba" is a mother's brother.

source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַחַ֤ת שָׁנָה֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ חֲמוּטַ֥ל בַּֽת־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִלִּבְנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] son of twenty and one year[s] [was] Zedekiah when he became king, and one [and] ten year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem, and [the] name of his mother [was] Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

en.L: A son of twenty-one years [was] Zedekiah when he became king, and eleven years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother [was] Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.
en.B: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.
en.R: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for eleven years. His mother was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

es.L: Hijo de veintiún años [era] Sedequías cuando comenzó a reinar, y once años reinó en Jerusalén; y el nombre de su madre [era] Hamutal hija de Jeremías, de Libna.
es.B: Sedequías tenía veintiún años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó once años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Hamutal hija de Jeremías, de Libna.
es.R: Sedequías tenía veintiún años cuando llegó a ser rey. Gobernó en Jerusalén durante once años. Su madre se llamaba Hamutal y era hija de Jeremías, de Libna.

fr.L: Sédécias avait vingt et un ans quand il devint roi, et il régna onze ans à Jérusalem ; et le nom de sa mère [était] Hamoutal fille de Jérémie, de Libna.
fr.B: Sédécias avait vingt et un ans quand il devint roi, et il régna onze ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Hamoutal, fille de Jérémie, de Libna.
fr.R: Sédécias avait vingt et un ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant onze ans. Sa mère s’appelait Hamoutal ; c’était la fille de Jérémie, de Libna.

sw.L: Sedekia [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, na miaka kumi na mmoja alitawala huko Yerusalemu; na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Hamutali binti Yeremia wa Libna.
sw.B: Sedekia alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na mmoja huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Hamutali binti Yeremia wa Libna.
sw.R: Sedekia alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka kumi na mmoja. Mama yake aliitwa Hamutali binti Yeremia wa Libna.

vi.L: Sê-đê-kia [được] hai mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì mười một năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ ông [là] Ha-mu-tanh con gái Giê-rê-mi, người Líp-na.
vi.B: Sê-đê-kia được hai mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười một năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Ha-mu-tanh con gái Giê-rê-mi, người Líp-na.
vi.R: Sê-đê-kia được hai mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua. Ông cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem mười một năm. Mẹ vua tên là Ha-mu-tanh, con gái Giê-rê-mi, người Líp-na.

ko.L: 시드기야가 왕이 되었을 때 이십일 세[였고], 예루살렘에서 십일 년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 립나 출신 예레미야의 딸 하무달이었다.
ko.B: 시드기야는 이십일 세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 십일 년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 립나 출신 예레미야의 딸 하무달이었다.
ko.R: 시드기야는 스물한 살에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 십일 년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 립나 출신 예레미야의 딸 하무달이었다.

decisions.choice: the same words in Jeremiah 52:1 and in 2 Chronicles 36:11
decisions.reason: Verses 18-20 are repeated almost word for word in Jeremiah 52:1-3, which begins that book's account of Jerusalem's fall. 2 Chronicles 36:11 gives the same age and length of reign but leaves out his mother.

decisions.choice: Hamutal: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) spell the name Hamital; the scribes marked Hamutal to be read aloud (qere), the form used in 23:31. It is the same woman.

decisions.choice: Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah: also the mother of Jehoahaz
decisions.reason: Hamutal was the mother of Jehoahaz as well (23:31), so Zedekiah was his full brother and a half brother of Jehoiakim. Her father Jeremiah of Libnah, a town in the lowland of Judah, is not the prophet Jeremiah, who came from Anathoth (Jeremiah 1:1).

decisions.choice: eleven years: from 597 BC to the fall of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Zedekiah reigned until the city fell in his eleventh year (25:2), about 586 BC.

decisions.choice: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old
decisions.reason: As in verse 8: Balanced and Readable give the age as English does and put the name first.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה יְהוֹיָקִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, according to all that had done Jehoiakim.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as Jehoiakim had done.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil, just as Jehoiakim had done.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, conforme a todo lo que había hecho Joacim.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tal como lo había hecho Joacim.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, tal como lo había hecho Joacim.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon tout ce qu’avait fait Joïaqim.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, tout comme Joïaqim.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais, comme Joïaqim l’avait fait.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sawasawa na yote aliyoyafanya Yehoyakimu.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama Yehoyakimu alivyofanya.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya, kama Yehoyakimu alivyofanya.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo mọi điều Giê-hô-gia-kim đã làm.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như Giê-hô-gia-kim đã làm.
vi.R: Ông làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, như Giê-hô-gia-kim đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 여호야김이 한 모든 일대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.B: 그는 여호야김이 한 그대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.R: 그는 여호야김처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다.

decisions.choice: according to all that Jehoiakim had done: measured against his brother
decisions.reason: Zedekiah is compared with his brother Jehoiakim, not with his father Josiah. The book of Jeremiah shows him unwilling to heed the prophet's word even when he asked for it (Jeremiah 37-38). Jeremiah 52:2 has the same words.

records.literal_gloss: For on [the] anger of Yahweh it happened in Jerusalem and in Judah, until he cast them from on his face; and rebelled Zedekiah against [the] king of Babylon.

en.L: For because of the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} it came to be in Jerusalem and in Judah, until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cast them out from before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face. And Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
en.B: It was because of the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that all this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cast them out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence. And Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
en.R: All this happened to Jerusalem and Judah because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was angry with them, until at last {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} threw them out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

es.L: Porque a causa de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} sucedió [esto] en Jerusalén y en Judá, hasta que los echó de delante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro. Y Sedequías se rebeló contra el rey de Babilonia.
es.B: Fue por la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que todo esto sucedió en Jerusalén y en Judá, hasta que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los echó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia. Y Sedequías se rebeló contra el rey de Babilonia.
es.R: Todo esto les sucedió a Jerusalén y a Judá porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estaba enojado con ellos, hasta que por fin los echó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia. Entonces Sedequías se rebeló contra el rey de Babilonia.

fr.L: Car à cause de la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, cela arriva à Jérusalem et en Juda, jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les eût rejetés de devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face. Et Sédécias se révolta contre le roi de Babylone.

fr.R: Tout cela est arrivé à Jérusalem et à Juda parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était en colère contre eux, jusqu’au jour où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a rejetés loin de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Ensuite Sédécias s’est révolté contre le roi de Babylone.

sw.R: Hayo yote yaliipata Yerusalemu na Yuda kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwakasirikia, mpaka mwishowe akawatupa kutoka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Kisha Sedekia akamwasi mfalme wa Babeli.

vi.R: Mọi việc ấy xảy đến cho Giê-ru-sa-lem và Giu-đa vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giận họ, cho đến cuối cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ném họ ra khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Rồi Sê-đê-kia nổi loạn chống lại vua Ba-by-lôn.

ko.R: 이 모든 일이 예루살렘과 유다에 일어난 것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 노하셨기 때문이다. 마침내 그분께서는 그들을 그분 앞에서 쫓아내셨다. 그 뒤에 시드기야는 바빌론 왕에게 반역했다.

decisions.choice: because of Yahweh's anger it came to be: the events of Zedekiah's reign happened through Yahweh's anger
alternatives: Yahweh's anger was against Jerusalem and Judah
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject, and the sentence means that what happened in Jerusalem and Judah, the evil of its kings and the disaster that followed, came about through Yahweh's anger. It may also be read "Yahweh's anger came upon Jerusalem and Judah", with the anger itself as the subject; the sense is close.

decisions.choice: cast them out from before his face: sent them into exile out of his presence
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, to be put away from Yahweh's face is to lose the land where he had made his presence known. The same was said of Israel (17:20). Its completion is told in chapter 25.

decisions.choice: Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon: Jeremiah 52:3; 2 Chronicles 36:13
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:3 has the same words. 2 Chronicles 36:13 adds that Nebuchadnezzar had made him swear by God, and Ezekiel 17:13-15 calls the rebellion the breaking of a covenant oath. The rebellion leads to the siege of 25:1.

decisions.choice: all this
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "it came to be" has no stated subject; Balanced and Readable supply "all this", meaning the evil and disaster just told. Readable turns "the anger of the LORD" into "the LORD was angry with them" and adds "at last" for "until".
